ef2c9a29eeee.reason: A query with no searchable words (fts_query gives None) answers the model with a plain message, "error: give words to search for", which is the intended tool reply; database errors propagate with ? as in the other tools. sqlx cannot return an unexpected type here: the row shape is checked at decode and fails as an error, not a panic.
ef2c9a29eeee.title: Missing Error Handling

f109ccbec415.reason: secrets::mask keeps only the characters before the first letter or digit (quotes, brackets) and after the last token character; a prefix such as sk- starts with a letter, so the whole token, prefix included, becomes [hidden secret]. The secrets.rs test checks token=ghp_..., key: "AIza..." and a bare token.
f109ccbec415.title: Potential Data Loss in Masking
